{{Short description|Uniform polytope}}
{{DISPLAYTITLE:Uniform 1<sub>&hairsp;''k''2</sub> polytope}}
In [[geometry]], '''1<sub>''k''2</sub> polytope''' is a [[uniform polytope]] in ''n'' dimensions (''n'' = ''k'' + 4) constructed from the [[En (Lie algebra)|E<sub>''n''</sub>]] [[Coxeter group]]. The family was named by their [[Coxeter symbol]] '''1<sub>''k''2</sub>''' by its bifurcating [[Coxeter-Dynkin diagram]], with a single ring on the end of the 1-node sequence. It can be named by an [[extended Schläfli symbol]] {3,3<sup>''k'',2</sup>}.

== Family members ==
The family starts uniquely as [[6-polytope]]s, but can be extended backwards to include the 5-[[demihypercube|demicube]] ([[demipenteract]]) in 5 dimensions, and the 4-[[simplex]] ([[5-cell]]) in 4 dimensions.

Each polytope is constructed from '''1<sub>''k''−1,2</sub>''' and (''n''−1)-[[Demihypercube|demicube]] facets. Each has a [[vertex figure]] of a {3<sup>1,''n''−2,2</sup>} polytope, is a birectified ''n''-[[simplex]], t<sub>2</sub>{3<sup>''n''</sup>}.

The sequence ends with ''k'' = 6 (''n'' = 10), as an infinite tessellation of 9-dimensional hyperbolic space.

The complete family of 1<sub>''k''2</sub> polytopes are:
# [[5-cell]]: '''1<sub>02</sub>''', (5 [[Tetrahedron|tetrahedral]] cells)
# [[Demipenteract|'''1<sub>12</sub>''' polytope]], (16 [[5-cell]], and 10 [[16-cell]] facets)
# [[1 22 polytope|'''1<sub>22</sub>''' polytope]], (54 [[demipenteract]] facets)
# [[1 32 polytope|'''1<sub>32</sub>''' polytope]], (56 '''1<sub>22</sub>''' and 126 [[demihexeract]] facets)
# [[1 42 polytope|'''1<sub>42</sub>''' polytope]], (240 '''1<sub>32</sub>''' and 2160 [[demihepteract]] facets)
# [[1 52 honeycomb|'''1<sub>52</sub>''' honeycomb]], tessellates Euclidean 8-space (∞ '''1<sub>42</sub>''' and ∞ [[demiocteract]] facets)
# [[1 62 honeycomb|'''1<sub>62</sub>''' honeycomb]], tessellates hyperbolic 9-space (∞ '''1<sub>52</sub>''' and ∞ [[demienneract]] facets)
